name: EXM_CARDS
description: This table contains the corporate cards issued to individuals of the deploying company and the details of the corporate cards. Corporate cards can be Travel cards or Procurement cards.

columns.name: CARD_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a corporate card.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Name of the process that created the corporate card.

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application that owns the process that created the corporate card.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person identifier of the corporate card holder.

columns.name: CARD_NUMBER
columns.description: Number assigned to a corporate card by the corporate card issuer. Stored only when the number is invalid.

columns.name: CARD_REFERENCE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the corporate card in Oracle Fusion Payments.

columns.name: CARDMEMBER_NAME
columns.description: Corporate card holder's name that is embossed on the corporate card.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: MOTHERS_MAIDEN_NAME
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Not currently used.

columns.name: INACTIVE_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the corporate card cannot be used.

columns.name: CARD_EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: Expiry date printed on the card which is the date from which the corporate card is no longer accepted.

columns.name: CARD_PROGRAM_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the corporate card program which is associated to the corporate card.

columns.name: COMPANY_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the company account which is associated to the corporate card.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: MAX_PERIOD_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum amount that can be charged to a card during the statement period. Applicable only for procurement cards.

columns.name: TRX_LIMIT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum amount that can be charged to a corporate card for a single transaction. Applicable only for procurement cards.

columns.name: CARD_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of a corporate card at any given time, such as Active, Inactive, or Unassigned.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Type of corporate card, such as employee card and company card.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Category of a company card, such as centrally billed air travel card and centrally billed car rental card.

columns.name: PROCESS_FILE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the upload process run on the transaction file.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
